name: Kemono no Ikenie
original_name: 獣の犠牲 -ケモノノイケニエ-
source:
The main character spends gloomy days in a boarding school in the country side.
He doesn't study hard and is bullied by his classmates.
And when someone killed his beloved pet, he decides to use his inborn gift.
He uses his ability to communicate with animals and take revenge on them.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ055913.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角在乡村的一所寄宿学校里度过了阴郁的日子。
他学习不努力，还被同学欺负。
当有人杀死了他心爱的宠物时，他决定使用他与生俱来的天赋。
他利用自己的能力与动物交流并对它们进行报复。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ055913.html/]DLsite英文[/url]]
